To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Rosemary Essential Oil (REO) nanostructured lipid carriers could accelerate infected wound healing.
the encapsulated Rosemary Essential oil (REO)-loaded into the nanostructured lipids carriers (NLC), showed antibacterial activity and accelerated infected wound repair in the animal model.

REO-NLC could reduce the rate and size of tissue bacterial colonization, while they increase the vascularization, re-epthilialization, collagen production and serum level of IL3, IL10, VEGFA and SDF- 1α in infected wound.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of REO-NLC as an efficient antibacterial and wound-healing agent.
the development and evaluation of a novel wound dressing containing REO-NLC to treat infected wounds in the animal model.
the development of new antibacterial wound dressings with the potential to be applied in clinical settings.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
REO-NLC has a significant potential in the treatment of infected wound healing.
the topical application of REO-NLC has a great effect on wound healing process in infected wounds.
REO-NLC could be used as a novel and efficient antibacterial agent for infected wounds.

the REO-NCLs could be a novel and effective wound dressing for treatment of infected wounds.
the REO-NCLs can be used for the treatment of bacterial infected wounds.

the REO-NCLs can be used as an alternative treatment for infected wounds.
